locations.rationale: `renderer` argument in `new Workflow(renderer)` resolves through the renaming import `ConsoleRenderer.{default => renderer}` in object App to the companion-object method `ConsoleRenderer.default`; the term reference is a call to that method.

`renderer` receiver in `renderer.render("  ok ")` inside object App resolves via the renaming import alias to `ConsoleRenderer.default`; `.render` is then invoked on the returned ConsoleRenderer instance.
Explicit import selector token `default` in `import ConsoleRenderer.{default => renderer}`; an import binding token, classified optional under the bindings_optional reference policy.
Rename target token `renderer` of the same import selector; it is the alias-binding half of the explicit import binding for `ConsoleRenderer.default`, classified optional under bindings_optional.
`renderer` here declares the constructor parameter of class Workflow (type Renderer); it is a distinct symbol unrelated to the import alias and does not resolve to ConsoleRenderer.default.
`renderer` inside Workflow.run resolves to the enclosing class's constructor parameter `renderer: Renderer`, not to the App-scoped import alias for ConsoleRenderer.default.
